nodes.name: Pd₁₂Ru₈₈/C synthesis
nodes.procedure: First, carbon black (BP-2000, 0.100 g) was suspended in ultrapure water (50 mL) with ultrasonic 0.5 h. Then, the palladium (II)-ammonium chloride ((NH₄)₂PdCl₄·H₂O) solution and the ruthenium chloride (RuCl₃) solution were mixed and stirred for 1 h. After that, the solvent was steamed with a water bath (80 °C) to obtain the hybrid and reduced at 400 °C in 90% N₂ + 10% H₂ for 2 h to get the Pd₁₂Ru₈₈/C sample.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of Pd₁₂Ru₈₈/C: First, carbon black (BP-2000, 0.100 g) was suspended... to get the Pd₁₂Ru₈₈/C sample.

nodes.name: Ni/Ni(OH)₂/C synthesis
nodes.procedure: A corresponding amount of nickel chloride hexahydrate (NiCl₂·6H₂O) solution was mixed in ultrapure water (100 mL) and vigorously stirred for 0.5 h. Then, NaOH (1.831 g) was dissolved in ultrapure water (10 mL) and injected into the mixture dropwise. After that, hydrazine hydrate (85 wt.% 25 mL) was added to the mixture, and carbon black was added (1.250 g). The reduction of Ni²⁺ gradually proceeded with mechanical stirring for 18.5 h. After filtration and vacuum drying at 60 °C, Ni/Ni(OH)₂/C was obtained.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of Ni/Ni(OH)₂/C: A corresponding amount of nickel chloride hexahydrate... Ni/Ni(OH)₂/C was obtained.

nodes.name: PdₓRuᵧ/Ni(OH)₂/C synthesis
nodes.procedure: The Ni/Ni(OH)₂/C catalyst (0.100 g) was suspended in ultrapure water (200 mL). The mixture was cooled by a sustained ice bath, and the aqueous (NH₄)₂PdCl₄·H₂O solution was added drop by drop. After magnetically stirring for 2 h, the RuCl₃ aqueous solution was appended to the mixture. After 2 h, the operation of filtration and desiccation were performed to gain the Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C catalysts.

nodes.description: HER LSV performance in 1 M KOH
nodes.source_text: HER electrocatalytic activity of Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C in 1M KOH electrolyte was evaluated by linear sweep voltammetry (LSV) at a scan rate of 5mVs⁻¹... All potential values in this work were calibrated to the reversible hydrogen electrode (RHE) with iR compensation. HER performance of Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C was remarkably superior... The typical polarization curve of Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C displays ultralow overpotentials of 16.1 and 97 mV to acquire the current density of 10 and 100mAcm⁻²

nodes.description: EOR CV performance in 1 M KOH + 1 M C₂H₅OH
nodes.source_text: All samples were controlled to have identical loading (10 μL, 2mgmL⁻¹) on the working electrode... EOR electrochemical measurements were performed with a three-electrode cell in 1M KOH + 1M C₂H₅OH electrolyte. The correlative CV curves were recorded till EOR performance was stable... The mass activity of Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C was 3.724A mg_PdRu⁻¹... Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C exhibited a remarkable CO₂ selectivity (20.9%)

nodes.description: HER stability test after 20000 cycles in 1 M KOH
nodes.source_text: the cyclic stability of Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C was evaluated by comparing the LSV curves before and after 20000 cycles... Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C even exhibited enhanced HER performance and the polarization potential... decreased by 41 and 50 mV after long-term stability for 20000 cycles at 100 and 360 mA cm⁻²

nodes.description: EOR chronoamperometry stability at 0.757 V vs RHE
nodes.source_text: Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C also exhibited outstanding stability during the long-term chronoamperometry durability measurement at 0.757 V (vs RHE) in 1M C₂H₅OH + 1M KOH
CO-stripping experiments... Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C exhibited a negative onset potential (0.23 V vs RHE)... The electrochemically active specific area of Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C (84.6 m² g_Pd⁻¹)

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-MS determines Pd (3.94 wt.%) and Ru (0.98 wt.%) loadings in Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C (Table S1).
nodes.evidence_snippet: the exact metal loadings were determined by inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS) (Table S1, Supporting Information). As shown in Table S1... Pd (3.94 wt.%) and Ru (0.98 wt.%).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni/Ni(OH)₂/C and Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C catalysts show Ni(OH)₂ crystal phase with no observable Pd or Ru peaks, confirming high dispersion.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The crystal phases of the Ni/Ni(OH)₂/C and Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C catalysts were determined as Ni(OH)₂. The signal peaks of Pd or Ru could not be observed...

nodes.characterization_summary: AC-STEM reveals atomic-level Pd clusters and Ru single atoms on Ni(OH)₂ nanoparticles with lattice fringes of 2.32 Å for Ni(OH)₂(111) plane.
nodes.evidence_snippet: AC-STEM characterization shows the formation of atomic-level Pd and Ru (Pd clusters and Ru single atoms)... The obvious lattice fringes (2.32 Å) could be assigned to Ni(OH)₂(111) plane.

nodes.characterization_summary: STEM-EDS elemental mapping shows uniform distribution of Ni, Pd, and Ru with Ni dominant and Ru lowest intensity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: STEM-EDS elemental mapping... presents the wide signal distribution range of Ni... Pd and Ru species are found to be uniformly distributed... with the intensity much lower than Ni.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni mainly as Ni(OH)₂, Pd as Pd(0) and Pdⁿ⁺ (Pdⁿ⁺ dominant due to surface oxidation), poor Ru 3p signal confirms low Ru single atom content.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XPS spectra reflect that the Ni species is mainly in the form of Ni(OH)₂, Pd is together with Pd(0) and Pdⁿ⁺... the poor signal of Ru 3p XPS indicates the low content of Ru...

nodes.characterization_summary: Surface metal contents measured for Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C and related catalysts; Pd and Ru surface contents reduce after thermal reduction to Pd₁₂Ru₃Ni₈₅/C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The surface metal contents of Pd₁₀Ru₅/Ni(OH)₂/C, Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C... were further measured by using high sensitivity low energy ion scattering (HS-LEIS) spectra.

nodes.characterization_summary: XANES at Pd K-edge shows Pd δ+ in Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C vs Pd(0) in Pd₁₂Ru₃Ni₈₅/C; Ru K-edge Ru⁴⁺-like single atoms; Ni K-edge dominant Ni²⁺. EXAFS: Pd-O (~1.6 Å), Pd-Pd (2.5 Å) in Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C; no Ru-Ru bond.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the XANES spectra of Pd K-edge... Pd K-edge XANES spectrum of Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C is located between Pd foil and PdO... There is only a single peak at 1.6 Å... no peak of the Ru-Ru bond can be found.

nodes.characterization_summary: ECSA of Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C is 84.6 m²/g_Pd, superior to other catalysts.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The electrochemically active specific area of Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C (84.6 m² g_Pd⁻¹) determined by CO-stripping experiments was superior to that of Pd₁₅/Ni(OH)₂/C catalyst (72.4 m² g_Pd⁻¹).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ex situ Raman shows Ni-OH and Ni-O vibrations at 400-600 cm⁻¹ for Pd₁₂Ru₃/Ni(OH)₂/C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The vibration peaks of Ni-OH and Ni-O are observed in the range of 400-600 cm⁻¹ of ex situ Raman.
